families.name: Security
families.description: Deterministic blocks on destructive commands, sensitive paths and file placement.

gates.description: Denies git reset --hard, recursive force deletes over protected areas, force push, git clean -f, and killing processes by name (Unix and Windows).

params.name: denyPatterns
params.description: Destructive-command rules: regex sources, or [regex, reason] pairs (a bare source gets a generic reason). Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: rmRfProtectedAreas
params.description: Paths that rm -rf may not target (e.g. /, *, src, tests).

params.name: embeddedInterpreterEnabled
params.description: Whether to block node/python -e that does raw file ops. Off by default.

gates.description: Denies unauthorized remote publish (git push, gh pr merge, gh release create). Disable to let the agent push on its own.

params.name: publishRules
params.description: Remote-publish rules: regex sources, or [regex, reason] pairs. Replaces the built-in list.

gates.description: Denies writes and mutating commands (Unix and PowerShell) to .env files, lockfiles and the Claude harness.

params.name: protectedPaths
params.description: Path fragments: a bare name matches the file's basename exactly (.env is not .env.example); a fragment ending in / matches that directory sequence (.claude/hooks/).

params.name: mutatingCommands
params.description: Regex sources matched at the start of a command segment whose arguments name a protected path; [] turns that rule off (redirections are always checked).

gates.description: Denies new root-level files/folders outside the project's whitelist.

params.name: rootFilesWhitelist
params.description: Root-level file names allowed to be created.

params.name: rootFoldersWhitelist
params.description: Root-level folder names allowed to be created.

gates.description: Denies sleep, tail -f, polling loops and foreground servers.

params.name: blockingPatterns
params.description: Blocking/waiting rules: regex sources, or [regex, reason] pairs, matched per command segment. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: waitJustifiedMarker
params.description: Comment marker that authorizes a justified wait as an escape hatch.

gates.description: Enforces that every background command (run_in_background: true) has an associated Monitor. Phase 1: denies background without MONITOR-PLANNED: marker. Phase 2: denies any execution tool while unmonitored backgrounds exist.

params.name: monitorPlannedMarker
params.description: Marker the command must carry to declare its Monitor plan. Default MONITOR-PLANNED:.

families.name: Delegation
families.description: Requirements on the brief of a subagent delegation.

gates.description: Requires goal, steps and done-when criteria in the prompt.

params.name: minBriefLength
params.description: Minimum brief length before it is considered complete.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the brief requirement (read-only work).

gates.description: Requires IN SCOPE / OUT OF SCOPE / EDGE CASES sections.

params.name: highImpactPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for high-impact work whose scope declaration is enforced.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the scope-list requirement.

gates.description: Requires LEVEL: QUESTION|MICRO|STANDARD|HIGH-RISK consistent with the request.

params.name: highImpactPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for high-impact signals that demand a declared level.

params.name: readOnlySubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the risk-level requirement.

gates.description: Cuts a delegation retried without substantial change: the attempt count is recomputed from stored signatures across the session (Dice >= similarityThreshold); retryThreshold below 2 is treated as 2. Only delegations that actually launched (allowed by all gates) count as attempts.

params.name: retryThreshold
params.description: Identical consecutive retries before the delegation is cut.

params.name: similarityThreshold
params.description: Dice similarity (0-1) above which two prompts count as the same.

gates.description: Denies a brief that relies on the subagent remembering the conversation (escape hatch marker allows a false-positive phrase).

params.name: memoryDependencyPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for phrases that refer the subagent to prior conversation.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Marker in the prompt that states no recalled data is needed (default memory-not-needed).

gates.description: Denies the Nth consecutive sequential delegation within a time window, requiring independent delegations to be launched together in one message. Escape hatch: SEQUENTIAL-JUSTIFIED in the prompt declares a genuine dependency.

params.name: sequentialThreshold
params.description: Consecutive delegations within the window before warning.

params.name: sequentialWindowMs
params.description: Milliseconds within which two delegations count as sequential; a larger gap resets the count.

params.name: sequentialJustifiedMarker
params.description: Marker token in the delegation prompt that skips the warning (a declared dependency).

families.name: Spec-driven flow
families.description: Only meaningful when the project adopted spec-driven development (feature list, specs).

gates.description: Judges the change to the feature catalog: at most maxInProgress features in_progress, and no feature moved to done by a direct write (shell redirects onto the catalog are denied).

params.name: catalogFileName
params.description: Name of the feature catalog file (default feature_list.json).

params.name: maxInProgress
params.description: Maximum features allowed in_progress at once.

gates.description: Non-empty requirements/design/tasks before in_progress.

params.name: catalogLocations
params.description: Paths searched for the feature catalog.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the spec requirement.

gates.description: Denies implementing a cited feature whose brief has no recorded user approval (status: approved + approval_quote frontmatter).

params.name: catalogLocations
params.description: Paths searched for the feature catalog.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the approval requirement.

gates.description: Definition, writing (verification) and a separate reviewer declared before building.

params.name: builderSubagents
params.description: Kept for compatibility: every subagent type not in exemptSubagents is held to the pipeline.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the pipeline requirement.

gates.description: Requires an active task with a contract before implementing.

params.name: activePointerPath
params.description: Path to the active-task pointer file (relative to the project root, or absolute). The task contract is looked up under <pointer directory>/<slug>/.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the live-task requirement.

gates.description: Requires a test matrix (types the requirement makes mandatory) in the brief.

params.name: e2eSignals
params.description: Regex sources that make an E2E row mandatory (money, auth, persistence, data loss). An empty list means never.

params.name: visualSignals
params.description: Regex sources that make a visual/QA row mandatory; a source starting with an escaped dot matches a file extension inside a path.

params.name: exemptSubagents
params.description: Subagent types exempt from the test-matrix requirement.

families.name: Quality and hygiene
families.description: Dependencies, diagnosis before patching, assumptions and language.

gates.description: A dependency new to the project (package.json write or npm/pnpm/yarn/bun install) requires a current skill.

params.name: depsWithoutOwnApi
params.description: Dependencies exempt because they have no API of their own.

params.name: projectSkillsDir
params.description: Directory where the project's skills live.

gates.description: Requires an origin-to-symptom diagnosis before a patch.

params.name: patchMarkerPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for temporary-patch markers that require a diagnosis.

gates.description: Before a new script/gate, state that no existing tool covers it.

params.name: executableExtensions
params.description: File extensions treated as executable tools.

params.name: toolFolders
params.description: Folders where a new tool triggers the audit requirement.

gates.description: Flags unverified assumptions in briefs and code.

params.name: conjecturePatterns
params.description: Regex sources for conjecture phrases (I assume, probably, should be...).

gates.description: Runs the project's own rules/*.mjs and .claude/skills/*/gate.mjs as sub-gates (payload on stdin; deny via JSON or exit 2). Only when enabled in the project's own .ai/config.json, never from the global config.

params.name: rulesDir
params.description: Directory scanned for rule gate modules.

params.name: gateFileNames
params.description: File names recognized as a skill/rule gate.

gates.description: A second occurrence of a defect class requires its deterministic block. Read-only commands, read-only delegations and the write to .ai/reincidencias.json itself stay allowed.

params.name: thresholdAppearances
params.description: Appearances of a defect class before its block is required.

gates.description: Denies creating a test after its paired implementation was already modified (escape hatch marker allows a regression test).

params.name: implementationExtensions
params.description: Source extensions whose paired test is checked.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Marker that, present in the test content, allows a regression test written after reproducing a bug (default test-after-impl:allow).

gates.description: Never re-ask what the user already answered.

params.name: overlapThreshold
params.description: Word-overlap ratio (0-1) above which a question counts as a re-ask.

gates.description: Denies voseo or regional lexicon in Spanish prose (text files, or content that reads as Spanish); code and English text are not scanned. Escape hatch marker allows a deliberate quote/fixture/log.

params.name: regionalMarkers
params.description: Regional words to warn about. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: textExtensions
params.description: File extensions always scanned as prose (default .md, .mdx, .txt, .rst, .html, .htm, .adoc, .json, .yml, .yaml); other files are scanned only when their content reads as Spanish prose.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Marker that, present in the content, allows deliberate regional text (default neutral-spanish:allow).

gates.description: Warns when a timeout/deadline/retry VALUE changes (Edit old vs new, or Write vs disk) without evidence; a new file never warns.

params.name: timeoutPatterns
params.description: Regex sources for timeout/deadline/retry keys to watch.

gates.description: Denies git commit while the project's lint script fails. Autodetects package.json's lint script; allows silently when none is declared.

params.name: lintCommand
params.description: Explicit lint command to run instead of autodetecting npm run lint. Default: autodetect.

params.name: lintTimeoutMs
params.description: Milliseconds allowed for the lint run before it counts as a failure.

gates.description: Denies a git commit when the STAGED files fail lint — lints only what you staged, not the whole repo, so your change can't add new lint debt while pre-existing debt in untouched files never blocks you. Autodetects eslint; escape hatch [skip-lint].

params.name: lintCommand
params.description: Command to run; staged paths are appended. Default: autodetect npx eslint when an eslint config exists.

params.name: lintExtensions
params.description: Staged file extensions that get linted. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: lintTimeoutMs
params.description: Milliseconds allowed for the lint run before it counts as a failure.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Substring in the commit command that skips the check once. Default [skip-lint].

gates.description: Denies a git commit that is not atomic: one mixing more than N distinct natures of change (code/tests/deps/config...) or staging more reviewable files than a commit should carry. Docs/assets/generated files are not counted. Escape hatch [wip] for one deliberately broad commit.

params.name: maxFiles
params.description: Max counted (reviewable) files in one commit. Default 12.

params.name: maxNatures
params.description: Max distinct counted natures of change in one commit. Default 2.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Substring in the commit command that allows one deliberately broad commit. Default [wip].

params.name: natures
params.description: Classification table of {name, source, counts?} objects, first match wins; entries without name and source are skipped. Replaces the built-in list.

gates.description: Denies a git commit whose message carries an AI/agent attribution trailer (Co-Authored-By, Generated with Claude/AI, session trailer), and a delegation prompt that orders one. Escape hatch marker allows one legitimate co-author.

params.name: attributionPatterns
params.description: Regex sources of attribution trailers/phrases to deny. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Substring in the command that allows one commit to keep a co-author. Default [allow-coauthor].

gates.description: Denies a write that silences the linter/type-checker (inline disable directive, or a config rule set off) instead of fixing the code. Escape hatch marker on the same line allows a documented false positive.

params.name: suppressionPatterns
params.description: Regex sources marking an inline suppression directive. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: watchedConfigFiles
params.description: Config file basenames (a * matches within a name, e.g. tsconfig.*.json) whose edits are scanned for rule-weakening. package.json counts only when it has an eslintConfig. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Substring on the same line as a suppression that allows it (a documented false positive). Default lint-ok:.

gates.description: Denies a code write that adds comments narrating what the code does. Only decision comments (why, trade-off, limitation), tool directives, TODO/FIXME and typed JSDoc tags are allowed. Judges only NEW comments (diff against the file on disk). Escape hatch: comment-ok: <reason>.

params.name: decisionMarkers
params.description: Regex sources (ES+EN) that mark a comment as a decision and therefore allowed. Replaces the built-in list.

params.name: escapeHatch
params.description: Substring inside a comment that allows it once (a documented exception). Default comment-ok:.

gates.description: Denies inline interpreter scripts (node -e, python -c, sed -i, perl -i, PowerShell Set-Content/Add-Content) when they perform file operations that the Edit or Write tool handles directly. Legitimate computation scripts are not caught.

families.name: Tool discovery
families.description: Do not reinvent the wheel: consult a per-project tool map before building.

gates.description: Before building a tool/helper (by folder, name pattern, or extension), requires evidence the wheel was checked: an audit phrase, the tool's name already in the map (structural match), or a matching installed dependency. Covers helpers beyond scripts/hooks/tools/gates and Spanish build-intent.

params.name: toolMapFile
params.description: Path to the per-project tool map (default .ai/tool-map.json).

params.name: toolFolders
params.description: Folder names marking a file as a tool/helper. Replaces the built-in list (scripts, hooks, tools, gates, lib, utils, helpers, composables, components, services...).

params.name: toolNamePatterns
params.description: Regex sources; a new file whose basename matches any is treated as a helper regardless of folder (useX, XHelper, XUtil, XService...).

params.name: toolExtensions
params.description: File extensions considered code that can reinvent a wheel.

gates.description: Records discovered tools into the per-project map so exploration is not repeated.

params.name: toolMapFile
params.description: Path to the per-project tool map (default .ai/tool-map.json).

params.name: toolFolders
params.description: Folder names (path segments) marking a file as a tool/helper. Same defaults as reuse-before-build.

params.name: toolExtensions
params.description: File extensions considered code that can reinvent a wheel.

params.name: toolNamePatterns
params.description: Regex sources; a file whose basename matches any is a helper regardless of folder.

families.name: Research flow
families.description: Engram persistent memory is the first source and the mandatory sink of research; library APIs are looked up (context7) instead of guessed, then saved.

gates.description: Denies WebSearch/WebFetch/context7 (and MCP research tools) until a mem_search ran in the session; blocks Stop while research happened with no later mem_save; at session start warns once when engram cloud is configured but the project is not enrolled.

params.name: engramServers
params.description: MCP server names that are engram (mcp__<server>__mem_*).

params.name: context7Servers
params.description: MCP server names that are context7.

params.name: researchTools
params.description: Native tool names that count as research.

params.name: engramUrl
params.description: Local engram daemon URL used for the cloud enrollment check.

params.name: requireSaveBeforeStop
params.description: Block the Stop event when research happened and nothing was saved to engram afterwards.

gates.description: Denies a write or shell command that imports a package the project does not use anywhere yet unless this session looked it up: an engram hit about it, or context7 docs followed by a mem_save. Shell heredocs are inspected; opaque redirections to code files are denied outright. Never guess a library API.

params.name: codeExtensions
params.description: File extensions whose imports are inspected.

params.name: ignoredPackages
params.description: Package names that never require a lookup.

params.name: maxScanFiles
params.description: How many project files are scanned to see whether a package is already in use.

families.name: Forge pipeline
families.description: Enforce the forge pipeline: a project that adopted forge routes every change through it.

gates.description: In a forge-adopted project, denies edits/commands unless an active forge run exists for it.

params.name: forgeDbPath
params.description: Path to forge's global SQLite DB (default ~/.forge/forge-mcp.db). forgeDatabasePath is accepted as a legacy alias.

families.name: Autonomy
families.description: Autonomous mode: block the question popup so an unattended run decides instead of asking.

gates.description: When autonomous mode is on, denies AskUserQuestion so the assistant decides instead of asking. Also blocks a turn from ending to wait (via gates/autonomous-mode/stop.mjs, a Stop hook sharing this flag): it re-injects, once per cycle, an instruction to decide and proceed, leaving pending only what needs the user's own explicit decision.

families.name: Completion
families.description: Enforce that a turn does not end while the project has pending work.

gates.description: Blocks the Stop event while the task store has active (open/in_forge) tasks for this project; lists them and how to close them with verified evidence (task close --check/--exists) or abandon them. Respects stop_hook_active.

params.name: allowStopWithBlockedTasks
params.description: When true (default), a task with status 'blocked' does not prevent stop; only open/in_forge do.

gates.description: Denies writes and execution when an active task has size > small/trivial and no sub-tasks registered. Forces splitting into smaller, independently verifiable sub-tasks before implementation begins.

families.name: Session start
families.description: SessionStart hooks: environment validation and project sync.

gates.description: Runs the environment validator and only speaks on failure.
In a project that never answered, makes the assistant ask what to adopt.
Warns when a registered hook is missing or a script is orphaned.

Injects the current catalog of the project's AI capabilities (skills, agents/subagents, commands) as compact context on every message, grouped by kind, read fresh from disk. Also persists it to .ai/capability-map.json like the tool map. Autosynced: it lists the directories, never a hardcoded copy. Never blocks.

params.name: kinds
params.description: Which capability kinds to include: skills, agents, commands. Drop one to stop scanning it.

params.name: maxClauseChars
params.description: Hard cap on each entry's one-line blurb length. Default 120.

params.name: extraSkillsDirs
params.description: Extra skill roots (relative or absolute) scanned in addition to ~/.claude/skills and <project>/.claude/skills.

params.name: extraAgentsDirs
params.description: Extra agent roots scanned in addition to ~/.claude/agents and <project>/.claude/agents.

params.name: extraCommandsDirs
params.description: Extra command roots scanned in addition to ~/.claude/commands and <project>/.claude/commands.

params.name: persist
params.description: Whether to write the persisted map file. Default true.

params.name: mapFile
params.description: Path to the persisted capability map, relative to project root. Default .ai/capability-map.json.

params.name: injectEveryMessages
params.description: Inject the catalog only every Nth message of a session (default 10); a changed catalog injects immediately.

params.name: blurbOverridesFile
params.description: Path, relative to the project root, of a JSON map name -> hand-written blurb (default .ai/blurb-overrides.json).

families.name: Task tracking
families.description: Deterministic persistence of tasks the model registers via the CLI, with reminders and a session-start recap. The model classifies and registers; the store enforces evidence on close.

gates.description: Asks the assistant to classify+register new tasks via the CLI, and recites active tasks every N messages.

params.name: remindEveryMessages
params.description: How many user messages between full recitations of active tasks.

gates.description: Lists this project's active tasks when a session opens. Silent when none are active.
